summary.headline: Astrological Entries 160–177
summary.text: Astrological catalogue entries 160–177 covering lunar affliction, stellar conjunctions and significations, Saturn–Jupiter conjunctions and transits, planetary friendship and enmity, zodiacal opposition, planetary power, houses, exaltations, and the lord of the eighth place. Entry 175 concerns someone seeking a sword and is edited in the appendix; entry 163 cites Codex Vindobonensis 2, folio 152v.
